scope: One fixed candidate on generated source bars and minute quotes, one native wallet. No historical array parsing, historical wallets, live operations, credentials, uploads, downloads, fitting, publication, or Git changes.
inherited_files: README.md and PROTOCOL.json describe the unchanged CONTROL. This document specifies only the newly fixed finite candidate.
candidate_CSH_proposal: 8/9 of the H090 CONTROL proposal. CONTROL remains unlagged original CSH times 1.5 with .90 gross, .30 asset, and .15 annual-volatility caps.
CSH_budget_use: Current actual native isolated balance attributed by actual same-direction owner quantities, plus cumulative actual fees, funding debits, and owner actual-fill realized losses. Realized profits and funding credits never replenish consumed costs or losses. This is an observational admission budget, not owner cash or an internal transfer.

finite.activation: First causally eligible original BTC-positive native daily decision; one program only, no restart, top-up, or compounding.
finite.add_trigger: Completed available mark at or below actual filled quantity-weighted owner basis times .95. Trigger authorization is stored with the order and checked atomically against fill, index, signal, side, and pending order. Execution follows native latency and capacity; a subsequent quote rebound does not rewrite the prior valid trigger.
finite.loss_exit_signal: Actual owner economic net PnL at or below -200 USDT. This is a paid-exit signal, not a guaranteed loss ceiling. Gaps, costs, capacity, and halts can overshoot.
finite.original_BTC_nonpositive: Permanently retire adds and execute paid finite-owner exit before any original CSH short opening. No opposing virtual ownership or phantom netting.

global_admission: 9000 original committed capital, at most 8500 actual isolated margin, at least 1000 free cash before and after charged increases, .90/.30/.15 combined actual and pending-corner gates. Increases are blocked at breaches; lawful funding and mark drift may cross gates and do not manufacture rescue cash.
execution_order: All reductions before any increases; finite exits before CSH reductions; CSH increases before finite increases; one shared prior-minute per-symbol capacity. Exact native account, clock and cost source bodies remain unchanged.
reservations: Full original owner allocations remain while actual inventory or pending increases remain. Paid-flat, cancelled, retired finite capital is permanently retired and cannot start another program.
owner_reconciliation: Actual native receipts are allocated once to explicit owners. Owner actual-fill realized/unrealized PnL is reconciled to the native blended-basis classifications with explicit bridges. Rounding bridges are disclosed and bounded at 1e-25; no receipt, PnL, margin, fee, or cash is altered to hide them.
historical_file_access: The inherited verified loader checksum-reads two already-public 2023 and 2025 target NPZ archives totaling 50586 bytes. Arrays are not parsed or used. Do not describe this as zero historical-file access.
recovery: Snapshots include owner quantities, actual basis, journals, funding allocations, pending orders and causal authorizations. Restore and fork remain deliberately unsupported.
